items.title: Pay course invoice (B1 intensive course + telc exam fee)
items.quote: Please transfer the course fee no later than 14 days after the date of this invoice, quoting the invoice number.
items.computation: Private invoice deadline, counted under §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB. Start of period: invoice date 29 January 2027 (a Friday); as the event that starts the period, this day is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB). Counting 14 days forward: 29 Jan + 14 days = 12 February 2027 (also a Friday, since 14 is a multiple of 7). 12 February 2027 is a Friday and not a public holiday in either Berlin (sender) or Nordrhein-Westfalen (payer's Land, relevant under §§ 269, 270 Abs. 4 BGB for payments to a company), so no § 193 BGB shift is needed. Due date: 12 February 2027.
